data.narrative:
9 Mothers is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Russell Smith, Roman Khomenko, and Bogdan Pyzh, having raised $4.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 10 peers: 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private entities including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic, spanning Seed through Series A stages.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total capital raised as a proxy for current value, applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $11M. Peer-median analysis across five same-sector and stage-adjacent comparables—including Stark Defence ($4.0B Series A), UFORCE ($1.0B Seed), Castelion ($1.0B Series A), Singularity ($400M Series A), and NODA AI ($125M Series A)—produces a $1.0B median, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $10M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $506M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around product maturity, revenue traction, and customer acquisition within the Defense & Security sector. Stage-progression and peer-median methods diverge significantly; the peer set's broad valuation range ($125M–$4.0B) suggests heterogeneity in technology focus, go-to-market model, and defense customer relationships that warrants detailed due diligence to narrow the implied range.
